annotations.title: Get a nursing home's Medicare record

description: Gets one nursing home's Medicare record by its six-character CCN. The record includes Medicare's star ratings, staffing hours and turnover, the latest inspection summary and citations, fines and payment denials, owners and ownership changes, the chain, and the Special Focus Facility and abuse flags, with the source files and their dates. The ratings are Medicare's. OpenHealth adds no grade of its own.

ccn.description: The nursing home's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 015009.
